description: Job listings from Google Jobs, 10 per page: title, company, location, salary, schedule, when posted, job highlights (qualifications, benefits, responsibilities), the description and direct apply links (Indeed, LinkedIn, company sites). Pass location for a city ("Chicago, Illinois, United States"); Google localises jobs to it. For the next 10, call again with the same query and location plus the next_page_token from the previous answer. Each page is one billed search. Without an API key, pay per call in USDC on Base with x402 (the first call answers with the price).

country.description: Two-letter country code Google searches from (gl), e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Default "us".

location.description: Search as if from this place, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, United States".

next_page_token.description: From the previous answer, for the next 10 jobs. Keep query and location the same.

page.description: Only numbers the jobs in the answer (page 2 starts at 11); paging itself is next_page_token.

query.description: The job search, e.g. "leasing consultant" or "property manager".

name: google_jobs_search
title: Google Jobs search
